title: Binary search
subject: Computer Science
objective: Find a target in a sorted list by repeatedly narrowing the search interval.
steps: Set low and high to the first and last indexes.
Compare the middle value with the target.
Keep the half that can still contain the target.
Repeat until found or the interval is empty.

title: Bubble sort
subject: Computer Science
objective: Sort values by comparing and swapping adjacent pairs until no pair is out of order.
steps: Compare adjacent values from left to right.
Swap when the left value is greater.
Repeat until a full pass makes no swaps.
Explain why the largest remaining value moves to the end of a pass.

title: Ohm’s law verification
subject: Electronics
objective: Observe the relationship between voltage, current, and resistance in a resistive circuit.
steps: Build a series circuit with a resistor and ammeter.
Measure voltage across the resistor and current through it.
Repeat at several safe supply settings.
Compare the measured ratio of voltage to current.
